To everything, there is a season, and I will leave here with great love and affection for my time in the Congress, thankful for all of the friends made, and very much looking forward to the next chapter of my life.

My full statement ⬇️
https://t.co/jv9i4KWh1j

Had the opportunity to discuss why #TN04 is the best place for the home of Space Academy with @FOXNashville this morning 🚀

With @AEDCnews, @MTSU, @VanderbiltU, @UT_Space_Inst, we are well positioned to grow and develop the next generation of @USSpaceForce Guardians 💫 https://t.co/5L7QtUj9h4

🌟 Tennessee’s Fourth Congressional District is officially making the bid to be the home of the U.S. Space Academy 🚀

Our great state is proposing the Coffee County Joint Industrial Park for its location, just minutes from AEDC and UTSI.

Read more here ⬇️ https://t.co/x2lqb7LRf3
Great to see the One Big Beautiful Bill at work growing our Tennessee economy! https://t.co/PEsHrBFcgd

It was great to be with Secretary Hegseth at @Smith_WessonInc this weekend. TN has recruited some of the best American companies to our state. I will always work to protect your #2A rights!

“The right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed.” -US Constitution https://t.co/UGbQIMoBeV

Happy to 251st Birthday to the U.S. Navy! Thank you to all our sailors for your service and sacrifice for over two centuries. 

It is because of the bravery of the men and women who defend our seas that American sleep peacefully at night. ⚓️🇺🇸 https://t.co/0QMfJUPKeo

Had the opportunity to catch up with Dan Mandis and discuss national debt, economy, and the ongoing conflict in Iran.

Listen here 👇 https://t.co/EQz2bsDhXC

I signed a letter from the Tennessee delegation requesting Acting Army Secretary Telle consider the Tennessee National Guard become the first National Guard to field the MV-75 Future Long-Range Assault Aircraft. 

Read more here 👇 https://t.co/VSf49eXD0e

Today, I met with Secretary Collins and discussed plans to keep the McMinnville VA Clinic open for the foreseeable future under VA management and staff.

Great news for the veterans of #TN04!

My full release: https://t.co/p9TO6BJ6uB https://t.co/cW69gh7pRN

“Over 80% of Americans want stricter voter ID laws. It is inexcusable for holdout senators to defy the demands of the vast majority of our citizens,” DesJarlais said.

https://t.co/HHMkMrmxxS

Had the opportunity to discuss ways the US can increase demand and opportunities for homegrown products here and abroad with farmers and leading experts in today’s @HouseAgGOP hearing.

Watch here 👇 https://t.co/NbMP1JjQT8

Great to be with the National Farmer’s Union this morning! Thank you to all of the hardworking farmers and ranchers around the country who are the backbone of ensuring our country’s food supply chain is secure 🌽🐄🌾 https://t.co/maFCHlOnjM

25 years ago today, our country came under the most deadly attack on U.S. soil in history.

Today, may we remember the families of the lives that were lost on that tragic day and the heroic actions of so many. America is at her best when times are at her worst.

One year ago today an act of political violence took the life of a young husband, father, and leader. 

This is not who we are as a nation and certainly not what we want to be. Civil political discourse is a freedom our great country allows. Acts of violence over disagreements will never be acceptable.

My office stands ready to assist any individual family members who may need help getting in contact with the State Department or other federal assistance. 

Amy and I are praying for those impacted by the devastating and deadly flooding in Nepal.

https://t.co/sJm1QwFClG

🌟 A stellar move on President Trump’s part 🌟

As we face increasing threats from our adversaries, we will begin training up the next generation of Guardians to protect and defend our great Nation. 🚀🇺🇸 https://t.co/nAnFUy8DWc

No one person has ever loved or done more good for the state of Tennessee than Dolly Parton.

Dolly’s contributions of time, energy, love, and resources to her state and her people will never be forgotten, and she will always be loved and greatly missed. https://t.co/Q2C0RG5yEm

Great to be on with Dr. Bill Kraus this morning on @WGNSRadio! We covered a number of topics from the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, the need to pass a Farm Bill, and more.

Listen here 👇 https://t.co/IdP0Yn26wk

Had the opportunity to catch up with @WzyxRadio last week. We discussed the SAVE Act, McMinnville VA Clinic, and more! 

📻 Listen here 👇 https://t.co/iuXXZYWnMr

Today, I oversaw a portion of the @HouseGOP debate on H.R. 7008, the Stop Insider Trading Act. 

This legislation enacts strict reporting requirements and policies regarding a lawmaker’s ability to buy and sell stock. Americans deserve the utmost confidence that members of Congress are not engaging in insider trading deals.

The @HASCRepublicans FY 27 NDAA: 

☢️ Prioritizes nuclear modernization

⬆️ Increases authorizations for programs to support Golden Dome

🚀 Streamlines space acquisition process & provides a historic funding increase for Space Force

💸 Supports pay raises for service members https://t.co/GDNYiLx28J

Amy and I are praying for the families of the two U.S. service members killed in Jordan, the missing service member, and for the protection of our troops overseas. May their loved ones be supported and comforted in the days to come.
https://t.co/QMp5yIy0Ow

Great meeting with the @TNFFAFoundation officers today! They lead over 31,000 members across our great state. It is incredibly encouraging to see the future of agriculture is in the hands of these bright and hardworking young folks. https://t.co/6Yga1wcpQ3

Today, I am overseeing debate on H.R. 1181 Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act and H.R. 139 the Sunshine Protection Act.

Watch here: https://t.co/CLIpeq3bet https://t.co/k2ZxVr5T81

Two years ago an assassination attempt was made on Trump’s life. In a moment of terror, he let the American people know he was unafraid.

May we never forget that no matter our policy differences we are all Americans and political violence will never be tolerated in this country. https://t.co/okeKVlsL8r

250 years ago today, our founding father’s had the courage to come together and declare the United States’ independence. They knew an uphill battle awaited them, but believed so strongly in establishing a country built on freedom that the risk would be worth the reward. https://t.co/zQJH4UsKIe

This is a victorious day for women, girls, and our daughters across the US! It is sad that it took a SCOTUS ruling for biological males to be banned from women’s sports. I am glad to see the sanctity of women’s sports will be protected for year’s to come. https://t.co/Mp87aAQnBN

Today, we honored the role that @AEDCnews has played in ensuring the security of our Nation for 75 years. 

This year America celebrates 250 years as a country.  This would not be possible without the men and women who work at AEDC to defend and deter threats to our homeland. https://t.co/stGWuevYCp

“I find it fascinating people from all these countries are coming here saying ‘we’re being told how terrible things are in America and how dysfunctional it is.’ And they’re just loving us. They’re going crazy over the food, the people, Buc-ee’s.”

Listen here @WGNSRadio 👇 https://t.co/eyEHAyRUhH

Happy Father’s Day to all of the dads, uncles, granddads, and father figures in #TN04! Thank you for all you do to raise up the next generation with strength and a solid work ethic. I hope you spend the day feeling loved and celebrated! https://t.co/XyrM6IfWq9

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
roll_calls.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. This vote would have replaced that bill with a broader ban that also forces members, the President, the Vice President, and their spouses and dependent children to sell covered investments they already hold. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

post.text:
Today, I oversaw a portion of the @HouseGOP debate on H.R. 7008, the Stop Insider Trading Act. 

This legislation enacts strict reporting requirements and policies regarding a lawmaker’s ability to buy and sell stock. Americans deserve the utmost confidence that members of Congress are not engaging in insider trading deals.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act (H R 1181)
roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 1181 (Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act) prohibits payment card networks from using merchant codes that distinguish firearms retailers from general-merchandise retailers or sporting-goods retailers. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act (H R 1181)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill prohibits payment card networks from using merchant codes that distinguish firearms retailers from general-merchandise retailers or sporting-goods retailers. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.
